# Purpose
This header defines a generated seccomp BPF policy for the `fd_snapld_tile` process and must not be edited by hand. It builds a syscall filter that first checks the runtime architecture and then allows only a fixed set of syscalls, with extra checks on syscall arguments such as file descriptors, socket domain, socket type, and socket options. The policy permits access only to `logfile_fd`, `in_full_fd`, and `in_incr_fd` for the approved operations, and it kills the process when a syscall does not match the allowed rules. The [`populate_sock_filter_policy_fd_snapld_tile`](<#populate_sock_filter_policy_fd_snapld_tile>) function copies the prepared `sock_filter` program into the caller buffer so the application can install the seccomp rule set at runtime.
